name: Bouldren · Gremlet #39
description:
A moss-covered boulder that wakes up every hundred years to stretch. This is one of those years.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Bouldren in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
